methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Virginia's AI challenge isn't data centers. It's small-business adoption | Guest column - Richmond Times-Dispatch
signals.signal_reading: Guest column explicitly identifies the real gap: while NoVA attracts data center infrastructure investment, small businesses across Virginia lack AI adoption capacity, signaling capability concentration in metros rather than distributed fluency.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Workforce pressure on Richmond's young talent suggests platform-level AI adoption creating shallow but broad exposure, as employers expect AI familiarity without necessarily building deep technical capability internally.

signals.title: University of Virginia Students Help Businesses Explore AI - GovTech
signals.signal_reading: UVA students directly helping businesses explore AI represents peer-to-peer knowledge transfer that could distribute capability beyond metros, though success depends on whether this scales beyond university-adjacent businesses.

signals.title: Norfolk firm creates AI versions of pupil photos to protect them from deepfakes - Yahoo News UK
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk firm developing AI deepfake protection demonstrates deep technical capability emerging in Hampton Roads defense-tech corridor, but remains concentrated in specialized firms rather than distributed across the regional economy.

signals.title: Roanoke citizens question potential data center plans in potential land development - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke citizens questioning data center land deals reveals AI infrastructure arriving without community engagement or local capability building—physical presence of AI economy without distributed access to its benefits.
